reason: No incremental value, and point (2) makes things worse. (1) Submitting each variant as K-stack + variant is already the v3 plan: K3b = K3 (or K2) + DeepCenter t*, K4 = current F1 stack + tempfuse (FINAL_REPORT v3 section e build list). (3) Keeping the insertion ON in every K build is already branch A. (2) 'Do not consolidate at S12' rests on a false premise. S12 ADDS a scored file (ILMDT) and removes nothing: ILM (K3), ILMD (K3b) and ILMT (K4) all stay scored and selectable. The finals choice is therefore made from a superset, so consolidation weakly dominates, and the slot costs nothing because S15-S16 on 28 Sep are unused. Under the idea's own priors (finals_mc2 priors plus T ~ N(+0.0004, sd); scratchpad pairslot_value.py), the consolidated file sits IN the argmax pair. With rider sd 0.0015: {ILM, ILMDT} U = 1.871 > {ILMD, ILMT} 1.865 > {ILM, ILMD} 1.849. With sd 0.0005: {ILMDT, LM} 1.905, {ILMD, ILMDT} 1.901, {ILMD, ILMT} 1.889. Skipping S12 costs U 0.006-0.016. The cited evidence ({ILM, ILMD} 0.960/0.889 vs {ILMD, LM} 0.952/0.851) compares leaving out D with leaving out I+D; it says nothing about consolidation. The pair/option mechanism itself (private = max of the two finals) is real and transfers, but it is already captured by the separate finals-pair-calculator and noins-twin-f2 ideas. Ceiling check: D and T are fork-only or near node-neutral riders. Their private effect runs through 0.1 x div_J plus the fork edges, so an unconditional range of +-0.002 is plausible, but the sd conditional on the public delta is smaller. That shrinks every pair-spread gain the idea attributes to itself. It is not a node-count artefact and not a closed line; it just adds nothing.
fix: Drop points (1) and (3); they are already the plan. Reverse point (2): keep S12 consolidation (it adds an option at zero slot cost) and add one sentence to the finals-pair-calculator rule: 'the S12 consolidated file joins the candidate set and never removes earlier scored K files (K2, K3, K3b, K4) from it; the calculator picks the argmax pair over all scored R5-admissible files'.
realistic_gain: 0 (or slightly negative: skipping S12 costs U ~0.006-0.016 in the idea's own MC). The real gain of the pair logic belongs to finals-pair-calculator / noins-twin-f2.
